units: <cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 30:18">Targ. II Chr. XXX, 18</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 8:1:6">Y. Sabb. VIII, beg. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>שתי ארבעתי כסוי דלילי פ׳</he> drank the four cups of wine customary at the celebration of the Passover night.

<cite ref="Chullin 129b:14">Ḥull. 129ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ זעירא</he> the minor Passover (= <he>פסח שני</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01256">preced.</cite>), the fifteenth of Iyar; <he>פ׳ רבה</he> the great Passover, the fifteenth of Nisan.

<cite ref="Pesachim 69b:2">Pes. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>קום מהול ועביד פ׳</he> go and get circumcised, and partake of the Passover lamb; a. fr.—Pl. <he>פִּסְחַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="Q00061"><he>פִּי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 15:4">Targ. I Sam. XV, 4</cite> <he>באמרי פ׳</he> by Passover lambs (h. text <he>בטלאים</he>).
